versions.localizedDescription: - Other improvements and fixes
- VODs by game: the filter now finds VODs where the game was played mid-stream, not only the one they started with
- Fix: picking a chat badge failed ("operation not found")
- Chat identity: also pick the badge shown on the channel you're watching (subscription, bits…), next to the global one
- Settings → Chat → Chat identity: pick the global badge shown next to your name in every chat (web session)

- Minimized player: the mini player at the bottom now shows the video, with play/pause
- New setting (Settings → Player): double-tap ±10 s on lives, instead of showing or hiding the chat
- @names in a stream's title (tap the title in the player) open their channel
- Followed categories: your Twitch account's categories also show without the web session

- VODs no longer stop with an error when Twitch has deleted the original sound of a muted part: the VOD starts again at the same place, with that part kept silent
- iOS 16: the app responds to touches again after minimizing the player
- The website moved to twitchunblock-web.pages.dev: the app's links to it now open the new address
- When the server gets close to its daily limit, the app pauses the usage count, announcements and polls until midnight UTC, so live streams and VODs keep working.

- Hidden tags: type the tags whose streams you don't want to see (“vtuber”, for example) in the hidden list in Settings, or long-press a stream → Hide the tag. Those streams leave Top, categories and search; synced with your account and the website.
- Picture in Picture is turned off in LiveContainer's multitasking mode, where it doesn't work (it stays in single-app mode).
- When a streamer delays their own stream (against stream sniping), the app says so once and shows the delay under the qualities, so it isn't mistaken for lag from the app.
- Channels that Twitch doesn't transcode only have the Source quality: the quality picker now explains it instead of looking broken.
- If your network blocks the Bulgaria source (often a DNS filter such as NextDNS or AdGuard), the app tells you which address to allow.

- Landscape chat: when the chat kept following the live but showed an empty area (it only came back after rotating the phone), the list now rebuilds itself.
- BetterTTV, FFZ and 7TV emotes that load after the chat has connected now also show in the messages already on screen; a service that didn't answer is tried again when you reopen the chat instead of never until the app restarts, and its failure is written to the log.
- Live rewind at 2×: with Low latency on, the catch-up speed was undone every second and the player got stuck; it now plays at the chosen speed up to the live edge.
- Channel ad break while subscribed: if an ad break comes although your account watches that channel ad-free, the app checks your account again and reloads the live through it; logged in without the web session, it tells you once how to watch ad-free with your sub.
- Viewer counts past a million now read 1.2M instead of 1234.6k.

- Connect an LG TV: Settings → Twitch Account → Connect an LG TV scans the QR code shown by the TwitchUnblock app on an LG TV and, after you confirm, sends it your Twitch web session, encrypted end to end, so the TV watches with your account (ad-free subs, followed channels). Only TwitchUnblock's Workers (or your own Worker) can receive it.

- New live source "My proxy" (Settings → Player): your own HTTP proxy (host:port, optional username and password, e.g. a TTV LOL PRO proxy). The playback token and the stream's playlists go through it while the video still comes straight from Twitch; if it can't be reached or refuses the credentials, the next source takes over and Settings says why.
- Following a category while your Twitch web session is connected now also follows it on your Twitch account; if Twitch refuses, it stays followed in the app.
- Player: new setting "Volume and brightness by swiping" (Settings → Player, off by default) — in landscape, swipe up or down on the right third of the picture for the volume, on the left third for the brightness, with a small indicator; the middle keeps the swipe down that minimizes the player.
- Settings → Backup: "Send my settings to TU Test" (or "to TwitchUnblock" from TU Test), shown when the other app is installed, opens it with your channels, settings and Continue watching; it asks Everything / Channels only before importing. Large backups go through the clipboard (Import from clipboard).
- Channel VODs: a game filter (All games by default) next to the keyword filter shows only the VODs of the game you pick, with the number of VODs per game, and loads older VODs when few are found.
- Player: in landscape, drag the chat over the picture by the small handle at its top — when you let go, it snaps to the nearest corner or edge (the six places of Settings → Chat → Chat on the video), to keep it clear of the facecam.
- Chat: new "Hide gifted subs" setting (Settings → Chat, off by default) hides the "X gifted a sub to Y" lines that flood the chat when someone gifts a batch, including the ones already shown; the batch message stays. Synced with the website and kept in the backup.
- Multi-live: the tile you hear can switch to audio only (🎧 on the tile) — a plain background replaces the picture, for less data and battery; the same button brings the picture back.

- Live sources: the public proxies (Luminous, PerfProd, nadeko) are gone — they let hundreds of ads a day through.
- New test source "Bulgaria": a TwitchUnblock relay in Sofia fetches the stream's playlists from Bulgaria, to see whether Twitch serves fewer ads there. Official Twitch takes over when it doesn't answer.
- Apple TV: live sources are now Bulgaria (test) and official Twitch; the public proxies were removed.

- VODs with no sound on Twitch: some channels record only an empty audio track in their VODs. A few seconds in, the player now notices it and says so at the top of the video ("This VOD has no sound on Twitch"), instead of looking broken.
- Apple TV: VODs with no sound on Twitch are now announced at the top of the video.
- Bug reports and shared or exported logs now attach the log in English, whatever the app's language (the logs screen still follows your language)
- Shared or exported logs now stay in French, the language they're written in, so I can read your reports as they are (the logs screen is still in your language)

- The Twitch source asks for its stream like Streamlink does, which Twitch serves with far fewer ads (pre-rolls and long ad pods). Contributed by ihavenoface
- During an ad pod the countdown now runs to the end of the whole pod instead of restarting with every ad. Contributed by ihavenoface
- Animated emotes play at their real speed: held frames keep their hold and very long emotes no longer skip frames. Contributed by ihavenoface
- Apple TV: The Twitch source asks for its stream like Streamlink does, which Twitch serves with far fewer ads, and the ad countdown runs to the end of the whole pod. Contributed by ihavenoface
- Other improvements and fixes
- Other improvements and fixes
- Other improvements and fixes

- Ad breaks counted for the website's /stats now include the live source and whether it was a Twitch pre-roll or the channel's own break
- Apple TV: Ad breaks counted for the website's /stats now include the live source and whether it was a Twitch pre-roll or the channel's own break

- Swipe from the edge to close the player now works even when the swipe starts over the video or the chat
- The mini player bar hides while the Picture-in-Picture window is open, and comes back when it closes
- The chapters list opens on the current chapter
- Importing a backup now works in LiveContainer without turning on its Fix File Picker option
- Other improvements and fixes
- Other improvements and fixes

- In landscape, the video takes the whole width of the iPhone Duo's outer screen, centered (it stopped at the status column), and the empty margin on the side away from the Dynamic Island when the chat is in a column
- Improvements and fixes

- Lives that come straight from Twitch (Twitch source, vertical picture) now filter Twitch's ad segments: the picture holds on the last frame instead of the purple ad screen, with the countdown, and the ads aren't downloaded. Higher qualities through your account still switch to the ad-free source (1080p) during an ad break, as before. Contributed by ihavenoface

- Lives that come straight from Twitch (Twitch source, vertical picture, Higher qualities through your account) now filter Twitch's ad segments: the picture holds on the last frame instead of the purple ad screen, and the ads aren't downloaded. Contributed by ihavenoface
- Other improvements and fixes

- iOS 16: the player's seek bar no longer stays on screen after minimizing the player
- AirPlay: low latency no longer jumps to the live edge while the stream plays on the TV, which kept freezing the picture
- An offline channel's page has a Chat button: Twitch keeps its chat open between streams, to read and write there
